en: Know what every product really earns on every channel
Know the real margin of every product on every channel
Margin on every product and channel
price, landed cost, fees, packaging, picking, shipping and return allowance give the margin of every SKU on all five channels with a verdict
Landed cost from freight and duty
supplier freight and duty rates turn the ex-works cost of every product into landed cost with the share of freight and duty
commission, payment fee, fixed fee and payout rules of each channel with their cost on an example order
target and floor margins by category and channel group, compared with the average margin you reach now
Supplier cost changes passed on to prices
every cost change is checked against the price history to show whether prices followed
each price change with its date, reason and size, kept for every SKU and channel
Price requests with a floor check
the margin at a requested price is compared with the floor before the owner decides, and slow decisions are flagged
Price tests with a decision signal
test price against current price with units sold at each, the total margin and a signal of who won
carrier cost against what the customer pays in every weight band and zone, and who pays the gap
component cost, the saving for the customer and the margin after fees for every bundle
discount, minimum order and case size by tier, with the margin of each tier and a check of each account
Promotion price plan with a margin check
promo price, discount and the margin given away for every planned promotion line

Product catalogue with landed cost and margins
One row per SKU with cost, weight, the five channel prices and status; landed cost, markup and the margin on each channel fill in by themselves.
Suppliers with lead time and freight and duty rates
One row per supplier with terms and the freight and duty rates that make up landed cost; products supplied, cost changes and the average rise fill in.
Sales channels and their fee rules
One row per channel and fee rule: commission, payment fee, fixed and monthly fees, payout timing and shipping rules; the cost of each fee on an example order fills in.
Margin by product and channel after all costs
One row per SKU and channel; price, landed cost, fees, packaging, picking, shipping and return allowance are taken from the other pages and give the margin, a verdict and the target and floor price.
Target and floor margins by category and channel group
One row per category and channel group with the margin you want and the floor; markup, products, the average margin now and a verdict fill in.
Packaging and handling cost per order
One row per parcel type or add-on with carton, filler, label and picking minutes; material cost, pick cost and the cost per order against your standard fill in.
Shipping cost against charge by weight band
One row per weight band and zone with the carrier you use and what the customer pays; the carrier cost from the rate page, the gap and who pays fill in.
One row per carrier and zone with base fee, rate per kilogram, fuel surcharge, minimum charge and transit days; the cost of a 1 kg and a 5 kg parcel fill in.
Supplier cost changes and whether prices followed
One row per supplier cost change with the old and new cost; the change, the web margin now and whether a later price change passed it on fill in.
Price history of every SKU and channel
One row per price change or first listing with the old and new price; the change, its size and the age of the change fill in.
Price change requests and how fast they are decided
One row per request for a new price; the current price, the gap, the margin at the requested price against the floor and how long the decision took fill in.
Price tests: test price against current price
One row per test with the two prices and the units sold at each; the margin per unit, the total margin, the gain and a signal of who won fill in.
Competitor price checks against our web price
One row per price check of a similar seller; our web price, the gap, how old the check is and whether it is the latest check of the SKU fill in.
Bundles with component cost, saving and margin
One row per bundle with up to three SKUs and the bundle price; component cost, the saving for the customer, the margin after fees and a verdict fill in.
Wholesale tiers, minimum orders and case sizes
One row per tier and category with the discount, the minimum order and the case size; the tier price, the margin and the cases needed to reach the minimum fill in.
Wholesale accounts with tier and terms
One row per wholesale account with contact, region, terms and tier; the tier discount and minimum order, a tier check and the sales tax rate of the region fill in.
One row per SKU and channel planned for a promotion with the promo price and expected units; the discount, the margin at the promo price and the margin given away fill in.
One row per region with the sales tax rate and the shipping zone; these are demo rates, check your own.
Launch tracker with first order cost and the 90-day review
One row per recent launch with the target margin and the first order; landed cost of the first order, the delay, the margin reached and the review date fill in.
Return and breakage allowance by category
One row per category and channel group with units sold and returned and the cost of the returns; the return rate, cost per return and the allowance used in the margin page fill in.

Supplier: your cost rise needs a reason
Hello, your cost rise on {sku} from {old_cost} to {new_cost} ({change_pct}) needs a written reason. Please send it with the date the new cost applies.
Hello {contact}, please send a new quote for {service} with unit cost, minimum units, lead time and freight and duty basis. Our usual lead time with you is {lead_days} days.
Supplier: confirm freight and duty basis
Hello {contact}, please confirm the freight rate ({freight_pct}) and the duty rate ({duty_pct}) you use on our goods, and who pays each.
Hello {contact}, we want to add a new product from {name}. Please send one sample with the unit cost, weight and carton size.
Hello {contact}, your minimum of {moq_units} units is high for us. Can you lower it for the next order or split the delivery?
Hello, please confirm how long the new cost of {new_cost} for {sku} is valid. We want to order before {date}.
Hello {contact}, we plan a larger order for the next season. What discount do you give for bigger quantities and what is the lead time of {lead_days} days then?
Hello, we confirm the new cost of {new_cost} for {sku} from {date}. Please confirm the same figures on your side before we order.
Hello, {product} on {channel} has a margin of {margin_pct} and the floor is {floor_pct}. The price for the floor is {floor_price}. Please check cost and price today.
Operations manager: cost rise to apply
Hello, the cost of {sku} rises from {old_cost} to {new_cost} on {date}. Passed on to prices: {pass_state}. Please prepare the price change.
Hello, please check the landed cost of {sku}: unit cost {unit_cost}, landed cost {landed_cost}, freight and duty {freight_duty}.
Hello, {carrier} sent new rates for {service}, zone {zone}. Please compare them with our shipping allowance and tell me what changes.
Hello, the price of {sku} on {channel} changes from {old_price} to {new_price} on {date}. Please update the listing, the images with prices and the next newsletter.
Hello, we launch {product} on {planned_launch}. Please prepare the photos and the text at least two weeks before.
Hello, the bundle {name} is ready at {bundle_price} on {channel}. It saves the customer {saving_pct}. Please list it from {on_sale_from}.
Hello, the price review for {category} ({grp}) is ready. Average margin now {avg_margin}, target {target}. Verdict: {state}. Please read it before we meet.
Hello, {product} on {channel} has a margin of {margin_pct} per unit sold. Verdict: {verdict}. Please decide whether we change the price or stop selling it there.
Hello, a price request for {sku} on {channel} is waiting: from {cur_price} to {requested_price}. Margin at the request {new_margin}. Please decide.
Hello {contact}, our wholesale price list for {name} is updated. Please check your tier ({tier}) and tell us if anything looks wrong.
Wholesale customer: new product in range
Hello {contact}, we have new products in our range. Your terms stay at {terms_days} days. Would you like the sheet?
Hello {contact}, your tier for {name} is now {tier} with a discount of {tier_discount}. The minimum order is {min_order}.
Hello {contact}, some of our prices rise soon because supplier costs rose. We will send the new list. Orders confirmed before the change keep the old price.
